dedupe_keys.name: betriebe nach storfallverordnung thuringen seveso establishments in thuringia

description: This dataset maps the establishments in the German state of Thuringia that fall under the Hazardous Incident Ordinance (12. BImSchV), the German implementation of the EU Seveso Directive on major accidents with dangerous substances. It combines the establishments published in the Thuringian spatial data infrastructure (GDI-Th), with object information naming the district or independent city responsible for each one. The original data are maintained by the districts and independent cities, and the metadata record is held by the GDI-Th competence centre at the Thuringian State Office for Land Management and Geoinformation; the record was created on 26 February 2025 with status ongoing. Coverage is the state of Thuringia, as vector data in ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N at a nominal scale of 1:750,000, classed under the INSPIRE theme production and industrial facilities. Data are available as Shapefiles through the responsible district and viewed through a web map service. Caveats: the data are the property of each municipal body under its own terms of use, no warranty of completeness or accuracy is given, and attributes are not described in the record read. For simulation it gives the locations of major-hazard sites for exposure analysis of nearby infrastructure and for emergency response and domino effect studies. It is related to the Hamburg Seveso inspection plan record in this catalogue, another German state listing.
